mapper.sql: d.id, d.doc_no, d.kind, d.order_id, d.partner_id, d.warehouse_id, d.biz_date, d.total_qty, d.total_amount, d.tax_amount, d.wms_doc_id, d.wms_doc_no, d.remark, d.replenish, d.dept_id, d.create_by, d.create_time, d.update_time, o.order_no, COALESCE(sp.code, cu.code) AS partner_code, COALESCE(sp.name, cu.name) AS partner_name, w.name AS warehouse_name, u.nickname AS create_by_name
